description:
Job Title: Full Stack Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Outside Continental US 
 
 
* * * 
 
 The Opportunity: 
CACI has an outstanding opportunity for a select GIS Full Stack Developer that wants to make a difference in the defense of the nation by applying their talents and experience in a fast-paced dynamic environment in support of US Special Operations Command. This opportunity is limited to self-starters with an advanced level of experience in planning, implementing, developing, and maintaining AI/ML applications for a GIS Enterprise and capable of working independently in a fluid custom application development environment. You will be an integral part of a selective professional IT team that directly supports the operational planning cycle to support mission success. This position is in support of a Department of Defense (DoD) organization in Fayetteville, NC.

 Responsibilities: 
 You will use advanced software development techniques to perform complex analysis, design and modification of applications and databases for applying AI/ML models in a GIS Enterprise environment. You will perform software development, deployment, and maintenance of custom solutions supporting geospatial intelligence by analyzing, writing, building, and deploying imagery, FMV, and geospatial AI/ML solutions in support of SOF objectives. You will support geospatial AI/ML initiatives by identifying, acquiring, transforming, and analyzing and visualizing current GIS datasets, to include crisis planning and contingency response. You should have excellent communication skills to include technical writing and the ability to work in a collaborative team environment. You should have the ability and willingness to continue to expand your knowledge and experience base to be detail oriented and to prioritize and complete assigned tasks within required deadlines. You should have exceptional problem solving and decision-making capabilities, including troubleshooting technical issues; successfully resolving project issues and challenges; and understanding user requirements to develop creative AI/ML solutions for process improvements. Using your knowledge and experience you will recommend innovative technologies that enhance the presentation and use of enterprise GIS products and provide integrated systems planning.

 Qualifications: 

 Required:  
 Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility

 8 years of professional experience in information technology with a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics or related quantitative field; OR typically 12 years of progressive experience managing the end-to-end lifecycle for the production of software applications.

 Experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and at least one application development language (C#, C++, etc.).

 Shall possess strong oral and written communication skills and be capable of effectively leading projects.

 Familiar with SQL (MSSQL, PostGres, MySQL, etc.).

 Familiar with developing and using REST APIs

 Obtain and maintain currency of the appropriate level certification per DOD 8570.01

 
 Desired: 
 Master’s Degree in Computer Science or similar field

 At least 3-5 years of professional experience using cloud computing services, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

 Experience integrating geospatial datasets.

 Familiar with REACT, NodeJS.

 Understanding of DevOps methodology

 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$85,800 - $180,200 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
